name: all-templates
description: A list of business types, one template repo each. The list enters at `list`; `dispatch` answers the first type and the rest, and that answer goes two ways: to `plan` (the same three neurons as one.network.json, named by their files) and back to `dispatch`, which hands out the next. The loop ends when the list is empty, at maxHops, or when the budget of repos is spent.

neurons.description: Hands out the list one type per call (neurons/dispatch.mjs) and answers quiet when it is empty. Two hops a turn, so maxHops 80 is forty types at most.
